headline: Bitcoin fell to about $81,000 on Thursday as tech stocks slid with the AI trade unwinding and Brent oil hit its highest level since May.

market.asOf: BTC, ETH and SOL from CryptoTicker's afternoon snapshot published 18:25 UTC 22 Oct (01:25 Bangkok 23 Oct). Fear & Greed could not be confirmed this run. Live prices are at the top of the page.

stories.title: Bitcoin slides toward $81,000 as tech stocks sink and oil tops $112
stories.summary: Bitcoin dropped from above $84,000 in a late-Wednesday sell-off, touching an intraday low of $80,836, and was below $82,000 by early Thursday, per Bitcoin.com News. Ether fell harder. Tech stocks slid on Thursday as the AI trade unwound, per Yahoo Finance, and Brent oil rose to its highest level since May. Crypto has been moving with tech stocks this week, and when prices drop fast, traders who borrowed to bet on a rise get forced out, which adds to the fall.
points: Bitcoin's intraday low was $80,836, per Bitcoin.com News.
In CryptoTicker's afternoon snapshot (18:25 UTC), bitcoin was down 4.0% over 24 hours and ether 5.4%; it put the whole crypto market at $2.83 trillion, down 4.2%.
On Thursday afternoon, before the close, the Nasdaq was down about 2.7% and the S&P 500 about 1.5%; in Yahoo Finance's afternoon quotes Meta was down 7.91% and Brent oil up 3.71% at $112.86.
Over $412M of bets on rising prices and over $43M of bets on falling prices were forcibly closed across the market, per Bitcoin.com News citing CoinGlass.
US jobless claims fell to 194,000, below the 200,000 expected, per FXStreet, so the jobs data showed no sign of a weakening economy.

stories.title: Bitcoin ETFs took in over $1B in three days, but the price fell anyway
stories.summary: US spot bitcoin ETFs, funds that hold bitcoin for stock-market investors, took in over $1B in the first three sessions of this week, and ether funds ended a five-day outflow run on Wednesday. That buying has not stopped Thursday's drop.
points: Spot bitcoin ETFs took in a net $528.4M on Wednesday, per The Block.
BlackRock's IBIT took in $235M and Fidelity's FBTC $212.7M, per The Block.
The first three sessions of the week added up to over $1.08B, per Nexo.
Ether ETFs took in a net $14.9M, ending five straight sessions of outflows, per The Block.

stories.title: US crypto rules stall: industry asks Congress for tax clarity as state regulators push back on the SEC
stories.summary: The Blockchain Association, a trade group, wrote to the top leaders of both parties in Congress asking for clear crypto tax rules, as the broader crypto market bill sits stuck in the Senate. Separately, the association of US state securities regulators (NASAA) urged the SEC to withdraw its proposed crypto fundraising rule. For everyday users, how crypto is taxed and which tokens count as securities are still unsettled.
points: The Blockchain Association's letter asks for a de minimis exemption (no tax on very small transactions), stronger taxpayer privacy and wash-sale rules extended to crypto, per The Block.
The CLARITY Act, the broader market-structure bill, stalled in the Senate after failing its first procedural vote last month, per The Block.
NASAA called the SEC's proposed 'Regulation Crypto Assets' 'preferential regulation in favor of crypto', per WealthManagement.com.
SEC Chair Paul Atkins says the rule would give crypto entrepreneurs 'clear pathways to raise capital', per WealthManagement.com.

briefs.title: Visa reported in talks to buy Fireblocks, which denies it
briefs.summary: Axios reported Visa is in late-stage talks to buy the crypto custody firm for about $2.5B. Fireblocks said the report is "not true at present time"; Visa declined to comment.

briefs.title: SoFi launches a 4.4% tokenized deposit
briefs.summary: The deposit is FDIC-insured within limits and swaps one-for-one into the SoFiUSD stablecoin, which is not FDIC-insured. Rollout finishes in November.

briefs.title: Coinbase Ireland fined about $3.6M
briefs.summary: The Central Bank of Ireland fined it €3.25M over customer-fund safeguarding failures from 2023 to 2025. Coinbase says no customer lost money; the fine still needs High Court confirmation.

briefs.title: Railway breach linked to drained crypto wallets
briefs.summary: Hosting firm Railway said an outsider may have accessed customers' stored settings. Researcher Taylor Monahan counts about $371,000 drained from wallets whose keys were stored there; Railway has not confirmed that link.

briefs.title: South Korea's crypto bill nears completion
briefs.summary: The financial regulator's chairman says the Digital Asset Basic Act, covering exchange licensing and stablecoins, is in the final stages of government consultations.
